description: This file defines the BubbleableMetadata class used for managing bubbleable rendering metadata in Drupal, including merging cacheability data and attachments.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Render\BubbleableMetadata
classes.description: A class for managing bubbleable rendering metadata, including cacheability and attachments, with methods for merging and applying metadata.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges this metadata with another CacheableMetadata object, combining attachments if applicable.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: Applies the metadata to a render array, attaching the stored attachments.

methods.name: createFromRenderArray
methods.description: Creates a BubbleableMetadata object from a render array, extracting attachments.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a BubbleableMetadata object from a cacheable dependency object, including attachments if available.

methods.name: addCacheableDependency
methods.description: Adds a cacheable dependency and its attachments to this metadata.

methods.name: mergeAttachments
methods.description: Merges two attachments arrays, handling drupalSettings and placeholders specially, following jQuery.extend() logic.
